name: Ashen Siege
summary: Ashen Siege is a real-time 1v1 strategy game for iOS and Android. Each player has their own arena and faces the same waves of monsters. The player moves a hero that attacks on its own, spends gold on hero upgrades and towers, and pays gold to send monsters into the opponent's arena. The hero who survives longer wins. A match usually lasts ten minutes or less. The game has 19 heroes, Normal, Ranked and Friendly online modes, and offline Vs Bot and Practice modes.
